problem: Sales psychology, sales methods, tone of voice and message-quality knowledge existed across Notion and runtime, but message_strategy was usually unlabeled and generic outreach could reach execution.
root_cause: Commercial intelligence selected who/when/channel but did not require a canonical sales-play and quality proof immediately before provider execution.
change: Canonical playbook with value-first, SPIN, Challenger, trigger outreach, follow-up, graceful close, commitment close, objection response and value-comment plays.
Human Sales Composer chooses/uses play context and performs deterministic quality checks.
Gmail and SalesRobot execution are fail-closed unless quality_passed=true on the actual current draft.
Strategy labels persist in sales action evidence so existing strategy performance/outcome learning can compare plays.
expected_effect: Every executable outbound message is context-specific, human, channel-bounded and learning-addressable by sales play.
